business_summary: Bank of Jiangsu Co., Ltd. provides various banking products and services in China. It operates through Corporate Finance business, Personal Finance business, Capital business, and Other businesses segments. The company offers personal banking services including private banking; investment and financing; personal savings; investment and wealth management; personal exchange; personal loans; payment, and welfare and sport lottery agency; and consumer finance services. It also provides corporate banking services comprising time, demand, structured, and current deposits; project financing and wealth management services; inward and outward remittance, export documentary collection and credit, import payment agency, and package loans, as well as L/C advice, review and negotiation, confirmation, and establishment services; money market, fixed income, and foreign exchange and derivatives; investment banking services, such as M&A and reorganization, structured financing, bond market, and securitization; and custody services. In addition, the company provides corporate loan, trade financing, finance leasing, guarantee, remittance and settlement, securities agency, credit card, repurchase transaction, and derivatives trading services; debt instrument investment services; foreign currency; and internet banking services, including direct, mobile, personal online, corporate online, telephone, SMS, and WeChat banking. The company serves individuals, corporations, government agencies, and financial institutions. Bank of Jiangsu Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Nanjing, China.
business_summary_ko: Bank of Jiangsu Co., Ltd.는 중국에서 다양한 은행 상품과 서비스를 제공합니다. 기업 금융 사업, 개인 금융 사업, 캐피탈 사업 및 기타 사업 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 회사는 프라이빗 뱅킹을 포함한 개인 뱅킹 서비스를 제공합니다. 투자 및 자금조달; 개인 저축; 투자 및 자산 관리; 개인적인 교류; 개인 대출; 지불, 복지 및 스포츠 복권 대행사; 소비자 금융 서비스. 또한 시간, 수요, 구조화 및 현재 예금으로 구성된 기업 뱅킹 서비스를 제공합니다. 프로젝트 파이낸싱 및 자산 관리 서비스; 국내외 송금, 수출 서류 추심 및 신용, 수입 대금 대행, 패키지 대출, L/C 자문, 검토 및 협상, 확인 및 설립 서비스; 머니마켓, 채권, 외환 및 파생상품; M&A 및 조직개편, 구조화금융, 채권시장, 증권화 등의 투자은행 서비스; 및 양육권 서비스. 그 밖에 기업대출, 무역금융, 금융리스, 보증, 송금 및 결제, 증권대리점, 신용카드, 환매트랜 등의 서비스를 제공하고 있습니다.
